commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

code.description: The code the provider's page shows after signing in, as it was copied: one token, with no space or line break.
